proves.claim: With line.landingBatchSize above 1, a landed land receipt posted through boardJobQueueCall merges its item, writes main-moved, and then calls the served landing starter once with the board root.

api.gate.land-reoffer.starts-after-settl.why: Without this test a batching board could leave items accepted while a land job ran waiting with nothing to offer them.

proves.claim: With line.collisionFreeBatch on, a stopped (red) land receipt lands nothing and calls the served landing starter once.

api.gate.land-reoffer.starts-after-stopp.why: Without this test a stopped land job could leave the items accepted meanwhile unoffered.

proves.claim: With the line defaults or landingBatchSize 1, land receipts call no starter and write the same board rows as with no starter, for steady and sprint items.

api.gate.land-reoffer.defaults-unchanged.why: Without this test the landing restart could change Steady landing for boards that never turned batching on.
